question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"never."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Never"** means not at any time or not on any occasion. (कभी नहीं; कदापि नहीं)

 
 
• **Example**:* I have **never**__ been to London.*
 
 
 
• It is the opposite of** "always"**, which means at all times or on every occasion. 
 
• The presence of the word** "nor"** in the following part of the sentence suggests that we need a negative word in the blank 3.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

Correct passage:

I was surprised __first__ at the news that my father spared me any thought, and second at my brother's compliment, __though__ it was backhanded. Dhri __**never**__ commented on my looks; nor did he encourage me to comment on his. Such useless ______ (4) ______, he believed, made people vain. Was this another ______ (5) ______ of change? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1:** "always (सदा, हमेशा; नियमित रूप से)"** implies a continuous or repeated action that occurs regularly.
 
• Option 3: **"forever (हमेशा के लिए; स्‍थायी रूप से)"** implies an infinite duration or a state that never ends.
 
• Option 4:** "ever (किसी भी समय)"** is a general term that can refer to any time in the past, present, or future.
